Visit date input opens empty; saveVisit refuses an empty date up front (no silent today-fallback)
visits.ems_task_id persisted partial-safe (only written when an EMS task id was actually sent)
Editing a linked visit pushes ONE EMS comment describing the diff, never a task PATCH/status change
נוכחות opens visits globally: single-visit day opens editor directly, multi-visit day expands to pick
Standalone דוח ביקורים page deleted from the bundle; cert/Excel tools and the monthly PDF survive
accessoryPlan: Landis meter→1 SIM direct; every non-Landis meter→1 controller; every controller→SIM+antenna+PS
renderCompanyCalendar() bails out once window.__sigmaCalendarIsland owns #calendar-view
calFetchEvents(range) asks the calendar Edge Function per day-range, caches per range, returns [] never throws on failure/no token
emsPatchTask/emsPatchTasks: N patches → N PATCHes → exactly ONE cache resync; partial failure reported, never swallowed
No legacy module still calls showPage('ems'|'mytasks'|'staff') — a sweep over every js/src file, not a hand-picked list
Delivery certs are created ONLY from the visit flow or the certs registry page — order-row/EMS-task 🚚 triggers removed, functions stay exported
No js/src file may reach, directly or via hoisted functions, a top-level const/let declared in a LATER file (build.mjs concat order)
UI copy never explains its own mechanics (Supabase/RLS/פונקציה/שרת/מודל/API/cold start)
No sentence tells a user who else (עמיחי/עידן/מנהל) sees his data
Data-flow/procedure vocabulary (זרימת נתונים, פרוצדורה, צינור, שלב N) deleted from the UI per spec §2
css/app.min.css and the critical <style> block are byte-identical to what css/app.css/critical.css minify to now, stamped with src-sha256
isDirectSupply (customer order, assignee='ספק ישיר'): approval produces NO stock movements and NO EMS task
Every export spec obeys the column contract: row arity, typed cells (n/d/s), no newline/bidi-mark/literal-undefined in a string cell
canExportExcel(): viewer✅ / idan✅ / team❌ / none❌
Every export/report cell prints productLabel's display_name, never the technical name, when one is set (spec §3)
Audit B F-06..F-23: the PDF and the Excel of the SAME report agree on grouping/labels/holiday-marker/empty-state and neither leaks a technical name
Real tag-stack walk over index.html: every element balanced (a stray tag silently reparents everything after it)
Every #*-view page is a top-level sibling block; no view nests inside another (showPage() display-flip integrity)
App chrome (bell, header island, user badge, EMS bubble) lives outside #kibbutz-view so it renders on every page
React→legacy goes ONLY through window.sigma; every sigma.<fn> call is provided, forwards to a real function, and matches the Sigma TS interface
Every sigmaBus event has both an emitter and a listener (or is declared ANNOUNCE_ONLY), and is declared in the SigmaEvent union
Every index.html island placeholder is mounted by some island, and no island mounts into a placeholder that doesn't exist
Every table the client reads/writes is declared by some db/*.sql file
Every reachable page has a #-view to render into, a canShowPage() gate case, and a showPage() redirect — the three must agree
Every client-sent edge-function `mode` is implemented server-side; every push-send mode nothing calls is either wired or explicitly CRON_ONLY
⋯ sheet registry rows carry a literal id and a resolvable Nav icon
Named cross-feature propagation (event → consumer) wires still exist for every plan-listed [event, emitters, consumers] triple
Every onclick="fn('${x}')" interpolation goes through an approved double-context escaper (jsArgEsc/devArg/attJsStr/…) or is provably not user text
No feature calls fetch/emsApi directly outside app/src/lib/ems/adapters/ (or the migration allowlist) — every EMS write goes through emsGateway() (spec §7o)
docs/integration-map.md must match the live tree — scripts/integration-map.mjs --check exits 0
buildCardHtml golden markup: region chip (with ללא איזור fallback), 🤝 marketing tag, multi-energy badge join, ↳ sub-site chip
groupBySection orders by REGION_ORDER then he-IL alphabetical, unknown regions after known ones, sub-site sorts right after its parent
db/kibbutzim.sql seed rows: valid section, no duplicate names, exact row count 54, correct re-homing per spec §2
db/kibbutzim_seed.sql: no empty region, every region is one of the five REGION_ORDER buckets
lastVisitLine(): shows 📍 last visit date, or ⏰ the oldest overdue EMS task due-date (red, 'ללא סיכום ביקור!') if no later visit settled it
emsModalTaskRow: title+status+FULL description+👤 assignee+📅 due, closing with priority/type bubbles in that order; every value escaped, degrades gracefully
orderUpdateRow/reqUpdateRow write ONLY the fields actually sent — a status-only PATCH must never wipe items/supplier/notes
visibleStatusOptions(isCust): customer orders show only 'supplied'; supplier orders keep the full supplier pipeline, never 'supplied'
approveCustomerOrder: blocked by kibbutzHasSite(kibbutz) gate before the EMS createTask enqueue, unless the order is drop-ship (isDirectSupply)
No table outside PUBLIC_READ_OK ends up with a SELECT policy reaching public/anon after all migrations run, in file order
No policy anywhere grants a write (insert/update/delete/all) to public or anon
inventory_alerts / stock_recounts keep no client UPDATE/DELETE policy — the only write is the SECURITY DEFINER alert_mark_seen() RPC
The 12 Apps-Script-era tables (LEGACY_TABLES) each end up governed by db/rls_legacy_lockdown.sql with RLS enabled and no anon reach
No physical-direction CSS/Tailwind property (margin-left/right, text-align:left/right, ml-/mr-/pl-/pr-) in the tokens-only regions, critical.css or app/src, unless marked rtl-ok with a reason
<html dir="rtl"> and every mounted island root sets dir='rtl' (a portalled Sheet/Dialog inherits nothing)
Every component interpolating a count/date/code into a Hebrew sentence isolates it in <bdi>; direction-implying icons are never hand-mirrored
sigmaSessionExpired: five concurrent 401s raise exactly ONE session-expired event and open the re-login sheet exactly once; a public cert-view link never sees it
sigmaBeginReLogin remembers the current page + scroll position (never the retired EMS page) and opens the login gate
A 401 during pass-mint-in-flight or within 2s of a fresh mint is ignored (not an expiry); the cold-boot read sequence awaits one memoized mint promise, one retry
The view-only PIN entry is no longer a client constant — it asks the ems-auth function, and a successful viewer login ends up holding a Supabase write pass like everyone else
180 min pass / 50 min re-mint / 10 min margin are ONE set of constants shared by js/src/15-login-gate.js, app/src/lib/remint.ts and the ems-auth function
The ≤767px bottom-nav takeover CSS (padding-bottom, #visitFab !important) only applies once body carries .sigma-nav-ready, toggled by Nav.tsx mount/unmount
Every localStorage write/clear of USER_KEY in 11-search-login.js / 15-login-gate.js is immediately followed by sigmaEmit('user-changed')
main.tsx/islands.tsx never eagerly import lib/query or lib/supabase; supabase-js and TanStack Query classes never leak into ui/sigma.js's boot chunk
ui/sigma.js stays under a 303 kB ceiling — a leak-detector for the data stack or an island sneaking into the boot chunk
אור הנר renders as exactly one card (⚡ חשמל + 🔥 גז badge, one map key), never split into 'אור הנר גז'/'אור הנר חשמל'
Each of the five sub-site cards is its own card with the right parent/grid/types, an ↳-parent chip, its own UUID, and no UUID shared across two map keys
Every card is mapped or explicitly KNOWN_UNLINKED; every mapped UUID is well-formed and appears under exactly one key; the arithmetic (mapped+unlinked=total cards) closes
After enrichCardsWithSheet, every card has exactly one .region-badge; REGION_FALLBACK is a fallback (never overrides a real Sheet region), idempotent on repeat runs
PROC_DONE / proc-btn / toggleProcedure vocabulary fully deleted from shipped files and js/src; parseTaskField/serializeTaskField drop it while still round-tripping legacy values
Cards in grid-done drop step/stepper/current-step-label/kibbutz-note (markup and post-enrichment); non-done cards keep them; the edit modal hides+clears them only for done cards
KIBBUTZ_SITE_MAP carries the corrected UUIDs (שלוחות, דפנה, קיבוץ ניצנים) and no longer the stale שלוחות UUID
emsSiteIdForKibbutz: exact (whitespace-normalized) live-name match only — no containment/fuzzy match; falls back to KIBBUTZ_SITE_MAP offline; kibbutzHasSite reflects the live cache once populated
No hex color literal inside any /* @tokens-only */ … /* @end */ region of css/app.css
Dark tokens are declared twice — explicit [data-theme=dark] and the OS prefers-color-scheme media query guarded against an explicit light choice — with the same surface tokens in both
ui/sigma.css never redeclares a legacy token name (--card/--border/--accent/--radius/--primary) on :root/html — shadcn tokens stay scoped to .sigma-root
index.html's <head> inlines the critical:start…critical:end block generated from css/critical.css, stamped with src-sha256, non-empty, carrying the first-paint selectors
No hardcoded white background in index.html or js/src (outside printed-document/paper contexts) — every surface must be able to flip in dark mode
body.user-viewer force-shows #viewerReportsHub, hides every write surface, and its hub controls are ≥44px (the only screen a viewer uses)
A running work-timer clock triggers a Web Push reminder after 2h with the phone closed, via pg_cron every 5 min → push-send timerStale → 22-push.js → the timer sheet
app/src/lib/clockify.ts and supabase/functions/push-send/clockify.ts are byte-identical, import-free, and share the ONE AUTO_STOP_MS=2h constant; a paused clock is excluded by the selector
▶ opens a work_sessions row (ended_at null); ■ updates that same row (or inserts if none); 🗑 deletes it; every row write is best-effort and never blocks the clock
sigmaTrack/sigma.track log through ONE wrapped showPage(), capped queue (TRACK_CAP=200), truncated target; wrapping twice never double-counts
Every legacy primary action (visit-saved, order-approved, cert-issued, ems-task-scheduled/created, stock-report) calls sigmaTrack guarded by typeof sigmaTrack==='function'
push-send usageDigest: auth checked FIRST (cron key or live עידן EMS login), Sunday-08:00 gated (bypassable only via auth.bypassGate), weekly tag idempotent, response carries no sentence text
usage_events: INSERT for authenticated only, SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE revoked from anon+authenticated; reads go through the usage_report() SECURITY DEFINER RPC restricted to עידן
track.ts stores only PII-safe shapes (searchMissTarget: results-count+length, never the raw query text); the unload flush uses a keepalive fetch, never sendBeacon (no header support)
app/src/islands/Usage.tsx is registered roles:['idan'], reads only via the usage_report RPC, uses zero hex/palette literals (tokens only), numbers wrapped in <bdi>
nextVersion: integer counter to 100 then rolls to 1.01; decimal minor auto-increments zero-padded; a major bump takes the whole-major era to the next whole number (e.g. 2.00)

gateViewerLogin asks ems-auth to check the code (never compares client-side); on success stores role=viewer + a Supabase pass + keeps the code for silent re-mint; refusal/setup-not-done/rate-limit all fail closed with no storage; gateLogout clears everything
